page.overview:
Who is Ulfila the Ostrogoth?

Ulfila the Ostrogoth is a non-canon character that made his one and only appearance in Mortal Kombat novel. He was a competitor in the Mortal Kombat tournament 500 years ago. He did not use martial arts, but rather, attacked violently with a spiked club and shield.

He got tired very quickly. Category:Article stubs Category:Wikify Category:Minor Characters Category:Mortal Kombat Novel Characters Category:Non-canon Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Characters
